output.attribution_rationale: The quasi-experiment compares AI control with conventional automated control using staggered activation, not-yet-treated plants, and interruptions within equipped plants.

achieved_dates.note: Section 2.4 gives first activation in October 2022 and observation ending July 4, 2025; Section 4.2 corroborates the start.

conflict.note: Operator and vendor data provision and internal assessments are disclosed in both texts, but the source establishes no vendor funding, author financial ties, or company control of the study.

output.summary: The working paper supports estimated reductions of 5.4% in electricity, 6% in electricity-related emissions, and 8.2% in energy expenditure under full AI control across the first ten post-activation weeks. Its 164-plant analytical sample includes untreated controls, and its observations end before the current twelve-month window.
